parsed.post: Reverting to 3734fbf (1.009912). The experiment with LR 0.07/warmup 0.1 was too slow to converge within the 5m window. Next, I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.06 with the existing 0.05 warmup to find a better balance for DEPTH=6 convergence.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 to find a sweet spot for DEPTH=6 convergence within the 5-minute limit.
